studentArchetype.description: An encouraging 3 to 5 word archetype capturing natural strengths.

narrativeSummary.description: A calm 2 to 3 sentence synthesis connecting preferences to pathways.

pathways.description: Exactly 4 distinct career match cards conforming to the designated tiers.

roleTitle.description: Specific, modern career concentration role title (avoiding generic umbrella titles like 'Engineer' or 'Doctor').

broadField.description: Broad academic or vocational discipline area (e.g. Information Technology & Systems).

overview.description: Single sentence summary of 30 words or fewer.

dailyTasks.description: 3 to 4 concrete operational tasks performed on a typical workday.

studyPath.description: Foundational study topics and courses of 65 words or fewer.

reassurance.description: Empathetic reassurance addressing academic hesitation and friction. Strictly 65 words or fewer.

majors.description: At least 2 associated college majors or degree concentrations.

minors.description: Optional complementary minors or secondary specializations.

trialCourses.description: Exactly 2 zero-cost trial courses from free platforms (e.g. Coursera Free Audit, edX, Khan Academy, freeCodeCamp).
